name: Novel Investor — Annual Asset Class Returns
description: A 15-year 'quilt' chart on the personal-finance site Novel Investor ranking annual returns across eight asset classes (large cap, small cap, international, emerging markets, REITs, high-grade bonds, high-yield bonds, cash) plus a diversified portfolio blend, from best to worst each year. Useful here as an alternate reference design for a ranked annual asset-class returns chart (the quilt/heatmap-grid form, as opposed to Callan's tile-table form), not as a data feed.

notes: The site also offers embed code and a downloadable image of the chart for reuse elsewhere, with an explicit 'Source: NovelInvestor.com' attribution requirement on the embedded version — narrower than, and an explicit exception to, the general no-reproduction Terms of Use below.
